title: Lumiose
description: Lumiose .stsx support: TSX with embedded CSS style blocks and $ref highlighting, and the Lumiose language server (TypeScript 7 takeover, CSS, project-wide classes and custom properties, snippets).

title: K8s View
description: Custom Kubernetes views with auto refresh, resource-bound commands, colored multi-pod logs and parameterized snippets, defined in JSON.

title: RabbitMQ Pattern Navigator
description: Ctrl+click a NestJS RabbitMQ pattern to jump between client.send/emit and its @MessagePattern/@EventPattern handler

title: MergeHarbor
description: Review your changes before you push, see pull request findings inline, and check the merge gate without leaving the editor.

title: The Seed
description: Create, build, sign and package games made with The Seed, a C++ game engine, from VS Code.

title: T-SQL Toolbox
description: Toolbox for SQL Server in VS Code: auto-replacements expanded with Tab, go to implementation, INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE data scripts, missing-WHERE warnings, a management panel, connections and an environment indicator.

title: Pi Coding Agent Sidebar
description: Chat with the Pi coding agent in a VS Code sidebar: multiple session tabs, fork from any message, steer a running agent, review diffs before edits land, and track tokens and cost. Unofficial.

title: MAD Live Watcher
description: Watches your web root (XAMPP / USBWebserver) and tells the Mad Live Reload Chrome extension to reload. Supports ignore patterns and an activity log.
